title: Object Storage: cool credit handling
content:
Object Storage cool credit is handled on request. Post one signed correction credit against a storage source charge. The agent records an immediately visible receivable reduction with its original charge and approved review references, and the posted receipt confirms success.

## Invocation

post_storage_correction_02018d1e. This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call) by the agent.

## Parameters

- storage_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Approved billing review reference copied from find_storage_events or a completed review receipt. This is the cool credit input.
- storage_holding_id: Id class — Identifier of the Storage contract reference copied from find_storage_holdings. This is the cool credit input.
- source_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Original storage charge reference copied from find_storage_events. This is the cool credit input.
- related_event_id: Id class — Identifier of the Approved billing review reference copied from find_storage_events or the review completion receipt. This is the cool credit input.
- customer_id: Id class — Identifier of the Enterprise profile reference copied from find_customers. This is the cool credit input.
- amount: Fixed-format class — Unit USD; format USD to two decimals. Signed receivable reduction in USD, decimal number with two decimal places, half-up rounded before submission and stored at two decimals; empty is not allowed. This is the cool credit input.

## Successful return

A string reading Correction posted with the correction event reference and signed USD amount; posted confirms the receivable reduction is recorded.
